Explore this 66± acre ranch for sale in Bosque County, Texas, offering a beautiful blend of scenic landscapes, recreational opportunities, and ready-to-enjoy improvements. Whether you're searching for a Texas hunting property, a weekend getaway, or the perfect place to build your dream home, this versatile ranch has plenty to offer.

A beautiful pond near the entrance creates a welcoming first impression, while a seasonal creek winds through the property, enhancing both the scenery and wildlife habitat. The ranch is fully fenced with electricity already in place, making it well suited for recreational use, hunting, or future development.

Property Highlights

• 66± Acres in Bosque County, Texas
• Beautiful Pond Near the Entrance
• Seasonal Creek Runs Through the Property
• Fully Fenced
• Electricity Already in Place
• Excellent Hunting and Recreational Opportunities
• Ideal Weekend Retreat or Future Homesite

Whether you're looking for Bosque County land for sale, Texas hunting land, recreational property, acreage with a pond, or a country escape, this ranch offers the perfect combination of natural beauty and functionality.
